title: Growth config: CONSENT_DEFAULTS
description: Consent, preference and communication defaults (ARCH section 9). Wording lives in the approved text versions, not here. Every default is PROPOSED_DEFAULT until the founder ratifies it (ARCH section 6.3 / 16). Unknown keys are rejected; secrets are never stored here, only secretRef names.

regimeId.description: Consent regime id, e.g. pdpl-eg-v0 (counsel NEEDS_HUMAN).

maxMarketingPerDay.description: Frequency cap across channels (Phase 2 enforcement). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1.

maxMarketingPerWeek.description: Frequency cap across channels (Phase 2 enforcement). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 3.

withdrawalPropagationSeconds.description: Withdrawal must reach the send gate within this many seconds. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 60.

bannerEqualWeight.description: Accept and Reject carry equal weight; no pre-ticked boxes. Not switchable.

textVersionIds.description: Ids of the approved wording; TODO_NEEDS_HUMAN_v0 until counsel approves.
